title: OIP Base CloudEvent Envelope Schema
description: Standardized CloudEvents 1.0 envelope schema for all asynchronous events published to the NATS JetStream event bus in the Operational Intelligence Platform (OIP)

id.description: Unique event identifier (UUID v7 or v4)

source.description: URI-reference identifying the context in which an event happened (e.g., /oip/core/incident-service)

type.description: The event type conforming to naming hierarchy (e.g., incident.created, ai.detection.completed)

subject.description: The subject of the event in the context of the event producer (e.g., incident.inc_789)

time.description: Timestamp of when the occurrence happened (ISO 8601 UTC)

datacontenttype.description: Content type of the data payload

dataschema.description: URI identifying the schema that data adheres to

correlation_id.description: Distributed tracing correlation identifier linking related causal actions

causation_id.description: Identifier of the specific event or command that caused this event
